answer.rationale: With only 14 days to expiry and the line at 94% of committed volume, changing primary supply or relying on a new second source creates unacceptable near-term delivery risk. The incumbent has demonstrated continuity, while prior records indicate that market benchmarking and multi-year/volume commitments can improve both price and payment terms. Verify those records before committing, then pursue a renewal structured to close as much of the mandated 18% spend reduction as possible without reducing service scope; the full target is not yet assured.
